verdict.rationale: Undermind's own MCP server exposes much of the core UI functionality programmatically: deep literature reviews, search with filters, bulk DOI and title resolution, author lookup, full-text PDF Q&A, workspace notes, folders and starring. A separate enterprise-only programmatic API with batch processing is claimed but not documented, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows that UI-only features (topic alerts, follow-up clarifying questions, custom tables, shared-workspace collaboration, team management, sort/filter of results) are reachable programmatically, so full UI parity is not established. missing for 10: documented public REST API/OpenAPI spec, programmatic access to alerts, team/workspace administration and collaboration, custom table generation, an explicit parity statement, independent hands-on corroboration of API/MCP coverage.
